"""Worst-case sized planning benchmark."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import ipaddress
from common import validate
from planning import solve

def build(nreq=4096, noff=8192, pairs=262144, seed=1, deep=True, costs='distinct'):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    leases = [{'id': 'L%d' % i, 'prefix': '2001:db8:%x::/56' % i, 'start': 0, 'end': 10**12 + 1,
               'subnets': list(range(16)), 'low_count': 8} for i in range(2)]
    services = [{'id': 'tcp0', 'kind': 'tcp'}]
    # deep-ish quota forests
    def forest(n, depth):
        nodes = []
        for i in range(n):
            if i == 0: parent = None
            else:
                d = min(i, depth)
                parent = 'q%d' % (i - 1 - (i % d))
            nodes.append({'id': 'q%d' % i, 'parent': parent, 'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, 5, 4096])})
        return nodes
    rq = forest(4096, 32 if deep else 3)
    oq = forest(4096, 32 if deep else 3)
    requests = []
    for i in range(nreq):
        lease = leases[i % 2]
        subnet = lease['subnets'][i % 16]
        iid = 1 + (i % 8)
        addr = (0x2001 << 112) | (0xdb8 << 96) | ((i % 2) << 80) | (subnet << 64) | iid
        requests.append({'id': 'r%05d' % i, 'at': 10, 'lease': lease['id'],
                         'target': str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr)), 'service': 'tcp0',
                         'group': 'q%d' % rnd.randrange(len(rq))})
    offers = []
    per = max(1, pairs // noff)
    for i in range(noff):
        listed = ['r%05d' % rnd.randrange(nreq) for _ in range(per)]
        listed = sorted(set(listed))
        plen = rnd.choice([32, 56, 64])
        base = 0x20010db8 << 96
        net = ipaddress.IPv6Network((base | (rnd.getrandbits(plen - 32) << (128 - plen)), plen))
        cost = rnd.randrange(10**9 + 1) if costs == 'distinct' else rnd.randrange(4)
        offers.append({'id': 'o%05d' % i, 'time': rnd.randint(0, 10**12), 'service': 'tcp0',
                       'prefix': str(net), 'capacity': rnd.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 4096]),
                       'cost': cost, 'group': 'q%d' % rnd.randrange(len(oq)), 'requests': listed})
    return {'version': 3, 'seed': 'sd', 'leases': leases, 'services': services, 'queries': [10],
            'captures': [], 'requests': requests, 'offers': offers,
            'request_quotas': rq, 'offer_quotas': oq}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for label, kw in (('distinct-costs', {}), ('few-costs', {'costs': 'few'})):
        job = build(**kw)
        t = time.time(); ctx = validate(job); print(label, 'validate %.1fs' % (time.time() - t))
        active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
        t = time.time(); plan = solve(ctx, active); dt = time.time() - t
        print(label, 'solve %.1fs resolved=%d cost=%d assignments=%d' % (dt, plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], len(plan['assignments'])))
PYEOF
